local_changes.scope: Private native ZML source experiment; upstream f430c353 does not load this split-expert checkpoint.
local_changes.model: Native AWQ INT4/asymmetric, group size 128; BF16 weights in layer 0, AWQ weights in 39 layers; decode dequantizes only the eight selected experts.
local_changes.chat: The local CLI implements the checkpoint chat template with thinking disabled and recognizes both generation EOS IDs.
local_changes.build: Bazel CUDA backend. Sequential compilation, 128 MiB loader DMA pool.

fused_awq_decode.implementation: Second local ZML build using fused dequantization and FP32 projection for eight selected experts during single-token decode.
fused_awq_decode.projection_oracle: Eight BF16 results on a tile of real checkpoint weights matched an independent CPU calculation exactly (absolute tolerance zero). Changing the FP32 reduction order can affect subsequent tokens.
